summary: Frontend-only verification of the new 'Raggruppa per Ordine' feature in Magazzino > Cerca Pedana at viewport 390x844. All 5 requested flows pass end-to-end against the real production backend (24 pedane / 12 ordini). Empty search renders magazzino-results-count = 'Tutta la merce registrata · 24 pedane · 12 ordini' and exactly 12 magazzino-group-{numeroOrdine} containers; each exposes magazzino-group-numero-{n}, magazzino-group-summary-{n} ('N pedan(a|e)[ · X colli]') and magazzino-group-progress-{n} ('Scaricate done/N'). Counts cross-checked against GET /api/pedane/tutte grouped by numeroOrdine - all 12 ordini match on pedane-count, sum(numeroColli) and sum(statoArrivo==='completo'); total 24 cards distributed across the 12 groups with no pedana appearing in more than one group. Tapping a magazzino-result-* card opens pedana-detail-card; magazzino-back-to-results-button returns to the grouped list with grouping intact. Partial search '019' still groups results (22 pedane · 11 ordini). Exact code '2619-019315' auto-opens pedana-detail-card. 'ZZZ-NOPE-9999' shows magazzino-no-results. magazzino-search-clear-button restores the full grouped list. No horizontal overflow of any group container or header text at 390 CSS px; no React Native red screen or new deprecation warnings. No data modified; office password unchanged (antolini2024).
critical_code_review_comments: magazzino.tsx groupByOrder preserves insertion order from the API (which is sorted dataConsegna DESC, createdAt DESC) so groups appear chronologically newest-first - correct and matches the design intent.

The pedana testID is 'magazzino-result-{codice}'. Real data contains duplicate codici across different ordini (e.g. 2619-019378 appears 3x, 2620-004471/2619-019344/2619-019331/2619-019314 each 2x). The grouping is still correct (each pedana shows in exactly one group), but the testID is NOT globally unique when scoped at the whole list - automation that locates a card by codice alone can resolve to multiple nodes. Consider including numeroOrdine (or pedana.id) in the testID (e.g. 'magazzino-result-{numeroOrdine}-{codice}') for safer test selectors. Non-blocking.
Italian pluralization is correctly applied in group header ('1 pedana' vs 'N pedane'); the ' · X colli' suffix is omitted when colli==0 which is appropriate.
Progress bar width uses done/g.items.length which is always >=1 so no division-by-zero (groupByOrder never creates empty groups).
FadeInDown delay is capped at index 6, keeping the staggered entrance snappy regardless of ordini count.
seed_data_creation: None. No TEST data created or modified; the 24 real pedane were only read.

Magazzino grouping testIDs: magazzino-group-{numeroOrdine}, magazzino-group-numero-{numeroOrdine}, magazzino-group-summary-{numeroOrdine}, magazzino-group-progress-{numeroOrdine}.
